activities.subject: Accountancy
activities.question: Explain the main idea of Chapter 2.
activities.instructions: Use the source-based options to complete this activity.
activities.sourceTextSummary: Generated from Accountancy - Financial Accounting - 2, Chapter Chapter 2.

correctItems.text: The preparation of simple final accounts pre-supposes the absence of any accounting complexities which are normal to business operations.
These complexities arise due to the fact that the process of determining income and financial position is based on the accrual basis of accounting.
Hence, many items need some adjustment while preparing the financial statements.
There may exist some receipts and expenses in the current year which partially relate to the previous year or to the next year.
